selected_effect: actual returned next-front obstructed after original chosen action
train_split: First eight of twelve frozen C28 FIT seeds per original family to train; last four each for internal FIT-only check. After scoring may fit remaining eight FIT episodes; no new holdout or DEV.

models.native: Separate action-specific nine original R1 LocalCell fast/slow predictor trained on public selected action outcome only; original R1/R2/R3 source untouched.
models.conventional: Independently implemented Beta count model per selected action, heading, current front status, with recency discount and full checkpoint.

protocol: Each FIT result prequentially predicted before training on its own actual selected return; report internal FIT-only Brier/NLL and samples by action and source family.
choice_probe: Hand specified uncertainty-versus-probe-cost decision proxy to test native-cell influence on constructed off-policy choice queries; not trained VOI or original-world utility.
stop_rules: Pin exact provider artifact original ZIP SHA256 and duplicate ledger/role/source identity or fail.
No source env import/reset/step; no new source episodes or previously consumed DEV.
No causal identification for unselected interventions from one on-policy trajectory; source obstacles autonomously move on each legal action.
Reject claims of native superiority without strong full-cost independent fitted controls and real source decision impact.
Fresh Python process must exactly restore native AND conventional outcome forecasts and proxy decisions.
Do not change FSA #83 protected scientific first-use; no merge, scheduler/controller, paid API, Library.
governance: Additive prereg-before-code draft child of source FIT C28; zeros for new source DEV and protected source first use.
